messages:
Ravi: Plan to tilt traffic from blue->green (router-main) tonight at 22:15 UTC. Change window 22:00-23:30. Strategy: fractional tilt 5->15->35->70->100, 3m waits. Gate: 2xx% > 99, rate-limit errors <0.2%, p95 < 400ms.
Nina: Copy. We also have a cookie rename (session_id -> session_v2). We should do a graceful dual-write for 15m after final cutover.
Carlos: Any session-affinity pinning needed during tilt? Some legacy clients rely on cookie.
Ravi: Yes toggle pin-by-cookie during steps 1-3, then remove pin at 70%. Will announce in release notes.
DeployBot: routeshift:init id=rs-20240621-77 payload={"from":"blue:20240621-1","to":"green:20240621-2","steps":[5,15,35,70,100],"wait":"3m","affinity":"cookie"} started by Ravi at 1748509876
SRE-Bot: Prechecks passed: infra-capacity ok, global-cache-hit 92%, backend-health 99.8%.
DeployBot: step 1 complete 8 green at 5%. metrics: 2xx=99.6%, p95=230ms, rate-limit errs=0.05%.
Emily: seeing a small p95 bump in us-west (p95 +90ms). Not alarming but flagging.
Nina: Hold criteria: if p95 > 450ms or errors >0.3% for >2m.
DeployBot: step 2 complete 8 green at 15%. metrics: 2xx=99.4%, p95=280ms. Cookie pin active for affinity.
Carlos: us-west spike worse: some edge-boxes showing 504s. Logs show upstream connect timeout to pool-west-12.
SRE-Bot: Alert: us-west edge-4 504 >0.6% for 3m.
Ravi: Pause global tilt. Apply regional pin to us-west -> keep to blue. @DeployBot region-pin id=rs-20240621-77 region=us-west to=blue reason="edge timeouts"
DeployBot: region-pin applied for us-west; global shift paused at 15%.
Emily: Running quick trace:
```
curl -sv http://edge-4.internal/route -H 'Host: router-main'
* Connected to edge-4
* TLS handshake ok
> GET /route HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
x-proxy: upstream-connect-timeout
```
Nina: Sounds like pool-west-12 instances exhausted during green rollout. Carlos, can you scale that pool and rotate?
Carlos: Scaling pool-west-12 3->5 and draining the new v2 instances for a different flavor. ETA ~4m.
DeployBot: scale:pool pool-west-12 request by Carlos status=initiated
DeployBot: scale:pool pool-west-12 completed. New instances healthy.
SRE-Bot: us-west edge-4 504 alert cleared. us-west 2xx back to 99.2%, p95 310ms.
Ravi: Good. Keep us-west pinned to blue for 10m of stable metrics then resume. Aim to resume at 22:40 UTC if stable.
DeployBot: admin:resume requires manual approval  please confirm when ready.
Emily: Metrics holding: 2xx 99.3% and p95 320ms for 8m.
Nina: OK to resume in 2m. Ill lift regional pin at that time.
Ravi: Resume now. @DeployBot resume id=rs-20240621-77 by Ravi
DeployBot: resumed 8 progressing to 35%...
DeployBot: step 3 complete 8 green at 35%. metrics stable. affinity cookie still dual-write.
Carlos: No more 504s. Proceeding to 70% in 3m.
DeployBot: step 4 complete 8 green at 70%. metrics: 2xx=99.5%, p95=290ms.
Nina: Removing cookie pin. Start dual-write for 15m before deleting old cookie.
Ravi: Final 100% in 3m unless alerts.
DeployBot: step 5 complete 8 100% traffic to green. All region pins cleared. metrics: 2xx=99.6%, p95=275ms.
Emily: Marking release notes: cookie dual-write, regional us-west pin, pool scaling in west. Owners Ravi/Nina/Carlos.
Ravi: Closing thread. Will open a brief post-release notes doc with observed warmup behavior in us-west. Thanks all. :rocket:
